root_cause: The existing Powerhouse daily-blog workflow staged the generated blog and i18n files but not a semantic Brain learning artifact, append-only development ledger or human-readable change note. Required admission for daily PR #4820 failed with INTEGRATION_BUNDLE_CLOSURE_INCOMPLETE.
fix: Add bounded, deterministic source-validated closure writer within the already existing daily publishing workflow, before creating its one canonical PR; preserve reviewed evidence on retry.
prevention_rule: Never publish a dated material content candidate without canonical Brain, append-only ledger, human documentation and exact source identity. Public readback and attribution are separate terminal gates. Reuse the one existing publisher and scheduler.
terminal_rule: This change is only live after exact-head Required/CodeQL, protected merge and a subsequent daily publisher run producing a properly closed candidate. No fabricated success.
